description: Housing Units (Occupied With Saudi Households) by Type of Housing Unit and Source of Water Supply is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). Explore housing unit data in Saudi Arabia by type and water supply source including semiannual and annual reports, apartments, villas, traditional houses, public piped water, wells, and more. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Economy, Water & Agriculture, Buildings. Its keywords are Supply, Housing, Residential, Housing data. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
